data.one_liner: Parse a git commit message using the Conventional Commits specification.
data.what_it_does: Parses git commit messages into structured data according to the Conventional Commits specification. It extracts components such as description, body, type, scopes, breaking changes, and footers.
use_when: You are building changelog generation tools or release management utilities.
You need to validate commit messages against conventional commit standards in Dart or Flutter.
avoid_when: You do not need to parse or validate git commit strings.
strengths: Provides a simple API for extracting all parts of a conventional commit message.
Handles edge cases like multi-line bodies, custom types, and breaking changes.
